title: Post-launch 30/60/90-day plan in docs/plan/ and artifacts/

implementation_summary.goal: Formalize post-launch 30/60/90-day operational and strategic plan across Days 1-30, Days 31-60, and Days 61-90, with weekly review cadence, 5 validated value hypotheses, RICE-grounded feature prioritization, and strict negative abuse enforcement.

key_items: M30-01: API Gateway Availability >= 99.9%, p95 Latency <= 300ms
M30-02: 24h Partner Inquiry Response SLA Enforcement (>= 98.0%)
M30-03: 162 Relics Source Lock Audit (100.0% coverage, zero unreviewed/disputed claims)
M30-04: In-kind infrastructure sponsorship burn monitoring against 202,360,638 VND cap
M60-01: FSRS Spaced Repetition Tuning & Anti-Burst Audit (Day-14 Retention >= 65.0%)
M60-02: Artisan Booking Settlement Turnaround (<= 48h, 90.0% payout)
M60-03: Mobile Offline Rubbing Sync Reliability (>= 99.0% success)
M90-01: B2B School Pilot Rollout (3 High Schools, >= 9 classrooms, >= 250 students)
M90-02: Post-launch actual GMV ledger reconciliation (10.0% platform take rate)
M90-03: Empirical audit of 10 Educational Research Studies (LN-01 to LN-10)

weekly_review_cadence.validation_rules: Scores must be within [0, 100], and omitting any pillar strictly raises ValueError.

negative_abuse_guardrail.invariant: No feature scale-up or investment expansion based solely on ungrounded demo applause or verbal feedback.
negative_abuse_guardrail.enforcement_mechanism: Proposals flagged with demo_applause_basis=True or verbal_feedback_only=True without a verified evidence pointer (EVID-* or ANALYTICS-*) have confidence capped at 0.20 and are immediately marked REJECTED_UNGROUNDED.
